questions.q_en: Why are they called "secondary" afflictions?

options.zh: 煩惱的分位差別與等流
options.en: phases and outflows of the afflictions

questions.explain_zh: 「唯是煩惱分位差別、等流性故，名隨煩惱。」
questions.explain_en: "Only phases of the afflictions and outflows of the same kind."

comparisons.title_zh: 受、想：作為「蘊」與作為「遍行心所」
comparisons.title_en: Feeling & perception — as aggregates vs. as omnipresent factors
comparisons.summary_zh: 同一個法，兩種分類：在百法中受、想只是五十一心所中的兩個（屬遍行）；在五蘊中卻各自獨立成蘊，因為它們是「諍根」與「生死因」。
comparisons.summary_en: One dharma, two classifications. In the hundred dharmas, feeling and perception are just two of 51 mental factors (omnipresent); in the aggregates each gets its own heap, because they are "roots of dispute" and "causes of saṃsāra".

cells.zh: 分類（聚）：過去、現在、未來、內外、粗細……一切受（想）的總集
cells.en: A category: all feelings (perceptions) — past, present, future, internal, external, coarse, subtle… — as one heap

cells.zh: 一念心中具體生起的一個心理作用（法）
cells.en: A single mental function arising in a given moment of mind
Five aggregates (a fivefold division of conditioned dharmas)

cells.zh: 百法 → 心所有法 → 遍行位
為何從眾多心所中單獨立蘊？——「諍根、生死因」
cells.en: Why a separate heap among all the factors? — "roots of dispute, causes of saṃsāra"

cells.zh: 為何是遍行？——「一切心中定可得」
觸、作意、思（這三者在五蘊中歸入行蘊）
cells.en: Contact, attention, volition (these three go into the formations aggregate)

comparisons.explanation_zh:
**同一個法，兩套分類。** 五蘊與百法是兩套不同的分類：五蘊是佛陀為破我執而把身心分成五堆；百法是把一切法逐一列舉。受、想在兩套中都出現，但角色不同——在百法裡，它們只是五十一心所中的兩個，與觸、作意、思同屬遍行；在五蘊裡，它們卻各自獨立為蘊，與其餘四十九心所合成的行蘊並列。

**為什麼受、想單獨立蘊？** 《俱舍論》頌：「諍根生死因，及次第因故，於諸心所法，受想別為蘊。」論中解釋，諍根有二：著諸欲、著諸見。由於貪味受的力量而貪著諸欲，由於顛倒想的力量而貪著諸見；又「由耽著受起倒想故生死輪迴」。

**為什麼觸、作意、思沒有單獨立蘊？** 它們同樣是遍行，但對生死的影響不如受、想顯著；其中思被視為行蘊的代表。

**考試陷阱**：問「受屬於哪一蘊」→ 受蘊；問「受屬於百法哪一位」→ 遍行；問「思屬於哪一蘊」→ 行蘊。五個遍行心所在五蘊中分屬三蘊：受→受蘊、想→想蘊、觸／作意／思→行蘊。
comparisons.explanation_en:
**One dharma, two schemes.** The five aggregates and the hundred dharmas are different classifications: the aggregates divide body and mind into five heaps to undo self-grasping; the hundred dharmas enumerate every dharma individually. Feeling and perception appear in both, in different roles — in the hundred dharmas they are just two of 51 mental factors, grouped with contact, attention and volition as omnipresent; in the aggregates each stands as its own heap, alongside the formations aggregate made of the other 49 factors.

**Why are feeling and perception separate aggregates?** Abhidharmakośa verse: "Because they are roots of dispute and causes of saṃsāra, and because of the order [of the aggregates], among the mental factors feeling and perception are made separate aggregates." The roots of dispute are two: attachment to sense pleasures and attachment to views. Relishing feeling leads to attachment to pleasures; distorted perception leads to attachment to views; and "because one clings to feeling and gives rise to distorted perception, one revolves in saṃsāra".

**Why not contact, attention or volition?** They are equally omnipresent, but less conspicuous as drivers of saṃsāra; volition is instead taken as the representative of the formations aggregate.

**Exam trap**: "Which aggregate is feeling in?" → feeling aggregate. "Which category of the hundred dharmas?" → omnipresent. "Which aggregate is volition in?" → formations. The five omnipresent factors spread over three aggregates: feeling → feeling, perception → perception, contact/attention/volition → formations.

quotes.text: 諍根生死因，及次第因故，於諸心所法，受想別為蘊。論曰：諍根有二，謂著諸欲及著諸見。此二受想，如其次第為最勝因，味受力故貪著諸欲，倒想力故貪著諸見。又生死法以受及想為最勝因，由耽著受起倒想故生死輪迴。
quotes.note_en: Verse: "Because they are roots of dispute and causes of saṃsāra, and because of the order, among the mental factors feeling and perception are made separate aggregates." Commentary: the roots of dispute are two — attachment to sense pleasures and attachment to views. Of these, feeling and perception are respectively the chief causes: through relishing feeling one clings to pleasures; through distorted perception one clings to views. Moreover, feeling and perception are the chief causes of saṃsāra: clinging to feeling and giving rise to distorted perception, one revolves in birth and death.

questions.q_zh: 在百法中，「受」屬於心所的哪一位？
questions.q_en: In the hundred dharmas, which category of mental factors does feeling belong to?
questions.explain_zh: 遍行五：作意、觸、受、想、思。
questions.explain_en: The five omnipresent: attention, contact, feeling, perception, volition.

questions.q_zh: 依《俱舍論》，受、想從眾多心所中單獨立為蘊的主要理由是？
questions.q_en: According to the Abhidharmakośa, the main reason feeling and perception are separate aggregates is that…

options.en: they are roots of dispute and causes of saṃsāra

options.zh: 它們在一念心中最先生起
options.en: they arise first in each moment of mind

questions.explain_zh: 「諍根生死因，及次第因故，於諸心所法，受想別為蘊。」
questions.explain_en: "Because they are roots of dispute and causes of saṃsāra, and because of the order…"

questions.q_zh: 遍行心所「思」屬於五蘊中的哪一蘊？
questions.q_en: Which aggregate does the omnipresent factor volition belong to?
questions.explain_zh: 除受、想外的心所都歸行蘊。
questions.explain_en: All mental factors other than feeling and perception belong to the formations aggregate.

questions.q_zh: 五個遍行心所在五蘊中分屬三個蘊。
questions.q_en: The five omnipresent factors are distributed over three of the aggregates.
questions.explain_zh: 受→受蘊，想→想蘊，觸、作意、思→行蘊。
questions.explain_en: Feeling → feeling, perception → perception, contact/attention/volition → formations.

questions.q_zh: 依《俱舍論》，由哪一法的力量而「貪著諸見」？
questions.q_en: According to the Abhidharmakośa, the force of which factor leads to attachment to views?
questions.explain_zh: 「味受力故貪著諸欲，倒想力故貪著諸見。」
questions.explain_en: "Through relishing feeling, attachment to pleasures; through distorted perception, attachment to views."

questions.q_zh: 百法中的「受」心所與五蘊中的「受蘊」是兩種不同的法。
questions.q_en: The mental factor "feeling" of the hundred dharmas and the "feeling aggregate" are two different dharmas.
questions.explain_zh: 是同一法（受），只是分類角度不同：受蘊是所有受的「聚」。
questions.explain_en: It is the same dharma seen from two classifications; the aggregate is the "heap" of all instances of feeling.

comparisons.title_en: Vijñāna in different schemes
comparisons.summary_zh: 識蘊（五蘊之一）、十二因緣的識支、十八界的六識界、唯識的八識——同一個「識」字，範圍與角色各不相同。
comparisons.summary_en: The consciousness aggregate, the third link, the six consciousness elements, the Yogācāra eight — one word with different scopes and roles.

cells.zh: 六識身；有部作結生之識

comparisons.explanation_zh:
**識蘊**：「於所緣境了別為性」，在唯識中攝八個心法。**識支**：《雜阿含經》說是「六識身」；《俱舍論》分位說是「識正結生蘊」，即投胎一剎那的心識。**六識界**：十八界中與根、境並列的六識。**八識**：唯識另立末那與阿賴耶。

讀經時先問：這個「識」在哪一個體系裡？
comparisons.explanation_en:
**Aggregate**: "discerning the object", covering all eight minds in Yogācāra. **Third link**: "the six classes of consciousness" (Saṃyuktāgama); in the Abhidharmakośa's phase reading, "consciousness at the moment of conception". **Six elements**: the six consciousnesses alongside faculties and objects among the eighteen. **Eight**: Yogācāra adds manas and the ālaya.

When reading, first ask: which scheme is this 識 in?

quotes.text: 識正結生蘊，六處前名色
quotes.note_en: Consciousness is the aggregates at the very moment of conception; before the six bases is name-and-form.

questions.q_zh: 依《俱舍論》分位說，識支指？
questions.q_en: In the Abhidharmakośa's phase reading, the third link is…

options.en: the aggregates at the moment of conception

questions.explain_zh: 「識正結生蘊。」
questions.explain_en: "Consciousness is the aggregates at the moment of conception."

questions.q_zh: 十八界中的識只有六個。
questions.q_en: The eighteen elements include only six consciousnesses.
questions.explain_zh: 眼識界至意識界六界；末那、阿賴耶是唯識另立。
questions.explain_en: Eye- to mental-consciousness elements; manas and ālaya are Yogācāra additions.

questions.q_zh: 唯識學中識蘊攝多少心法？
questions.q_en: In Yogācāra, how many mind dharmas does the consciousness aggregate include?
questions.explain_zh: 百法的八個心法（八識）皆屬識蘊。
questions.explain_en: All eight mind dharmas belong to the consciousness aggregate.

comparisons.title_en: Initial inquiry vs. sustained investigation (vitarka & vicāra)
comparisons.summary_zh: 尋是對意言境的粗略搜尋，伺是細密審察；二者皆以思、慧一分為體，差別在推度的深淺。初禪有尋有伺，二禪以上皆無。
comparisons.summary_en: Vitarka is coarse searching of the mentally-verbalized object, vicāra fine scrutiny; both are parts of volition and discernment, differing in depth. The first dhyāna has both; the second and above have neither.

cells.en: Operates coarsely on the verbalized object
Operates finely on the verbalized object
Looking for someone in a crowd
觀 (not the 觀 of vipaśyanā)

cells.zh: 初禪有（中間禪唯伺），二禪以上無
cells.en: 1st dhyāna (the intermediate dhyāna has vicāra only)

comparisons.explanation_zh:
**一粗一細**：《成唯識論》：「尋謂尋求，令心怱遽於意言境，麁轉為性；伺謂伺察，令心怱遽於意言境，細轉為性。」兩者都在「意言境」上運作——即以內在語言概念所把握的對象，差別只在粗細。

**體性**：「並用思、慧一分為體，於意言境不深推度及深推度，義類別故。」尋伺不是獨立實體，而是思（意志）與慧（簡擇）在推度上的兩種狀態。

**為什麼是不定**：尋伺可以是善的思惟（思惟法義），也可以是染的（計畫惡事），也可以是無記的（想午餐吃什麼）。

**禪修**：初禪有尋有伺；從初禪到二禪，正是讓尋伺止息，心進入「內等淨」的狀態。
comparisons.explanation_en:
**Coarse and fine**: Cheng weishi lun: "vitarka is searching, the mind hurrying toward the verbalized object, operating coarsely; vicāra is scrutinizing, … operating finely." Both work on the "mentally-verbalized object" — what is grasped through inner speech and concepts — differing only in grain.

**Substance**: "both have parts of volition and discernment as substance; they differ as shallow and deep reasoning about the verbalized object." They are not separate entities but two states of volition plus discernment.

**Why indeterminate**: they can be wholesome (reflecting on the Dharma), defiled (plotting harm) or neutral (planning lunch).

**Meditation**: the first dhyāna has both; passing to the second dhyāna is precisely their stilling, as the mind enters "inner clarity".

quotes.text: 尋謂尋求，令心怱遽於意言境，麁轉為性；伺謂伺察，令心怱遽於意言境，細轉為性。此二俱以安、不安住身心分位所依為業。
quotes.note_en: Initial inquiry means searching — making the mind hurry toward the verbalized object, operating coarsely; sustained investigation means scrutinizing — operating finely. Both function as the basis of states of ease or unease of body and mind.

quotes.text: 並用思、慧一分為體，於意言境不深推度及深推度，義類別故
quotes.note_en: Both have parts of volition and discernment as substance; they are distinguished as shallow and deep reasoning about the verbalized object.

questions.q_zh: 尋與伺的體性是？
questions.q_en: What is the substance of vitarka and vicāra?
questions.explain_zh: 「並用思、慧一分為體。」
questions.explain_en: "Both have parts of volition and discernment as substance."

questions.q_zh: 二禪以上沒有尋與伺。
questions.q_en: There is neither vitarka nor vicāra in the second dhyāna and above.
questions.explain_zh: 初禪有尋有伺，二禪以上無尋無伺。
questions.explain_en: The first dhyāna has both; the second and higher have neither.

questions.q_zh: 舊譯「有覺有觀」中的「觀」是指？
questions.q_en: In the old translation 「有覺有觀」, 觀 means…
questions.explain_zh: 舊譯以覺、觀譯 vitarka、vicāra，與止觀之觀不同。
questions.explain_en: Old translations render vitarka and vicāra as 覺 and 觀 — different from the 觀 of 止觀.

questions.q_zh: 為什麼尋、伺屬於「不定」心所？
questions.q_en: Why are vitarka and vicāra "indeterminate"?

options.en: they can be wholesome, unwholesome or neutral

options.zh: 因為它們只在夢中生起

questions.explain_zh: 不定心所「於善、染等皆不定」。
questions.explain_en: Indeterminate factors are "not fixed as wholesome, defiled, etc."
